name: Rendezvous Pipeline
researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 workbook (Historical Projects sheet) lists Rendezvous Pipeline Lateral at Excel row 412: operator Rendezvous Pipeline Company, completed, in service 2006-11-15, 20.8 mi, 20 in, 300 MMcf/d, interstate, FERC docket CP05-40, Wyoming. Row 434, Rendezvous Black Fork Lateral, has the same length, diameter and docket, in service 2007-02-08, 330 MMcf/d. Same docket and same 20.8 mi, so treated as one line (the second row is probably a capacity addition, not new pipe). Not in the GEM roster under any name; Kern River rows P0207 and P3856 are different lines. Not confirmed: the Uinta County to Lincoln County endpoints from the consolidator note (EIA gives only the state) so start and end locations are left blank. The 2008 Pinedale Online BLM article does NOT support this line (it describes Rendezvous 6, a different 100 mile project) and was not cited. No FERC order was read: the search tool hit a session limit. Owner entity not in gazetteer; team style spelling Rendezvous Pipeline Co. Single validated source (EIA, one origin), so medium tier. Route: no route found. Passes length rule (20.8 mi over 15.5 mi). Follow up: pair with the FERC CP05-40 order and confirm endpoints and capacity.
